answer_1.quote: We also use the generation-based method on our entity-to-entity stance detection experiments. Specifically, our generation-based model is trained on decoder-only language models, which takes input tokens and generates new tokens autoregressively... The model takes T(x, e1, e2) and produces a series of tokens o as the output of the entity-to-entity stance detection.
